source_units: is a free psychoacoustic distance plug-in for pushing close sounds farther back without obvious reverb. It is designed for the moments where a source needs to feel a few meters farther away, but adding reverb or dulling it with EQ makes the mix sound artificial.
AAX / AU / VST3 for macOS 11 or later
Latest downloads are available for macOS 11 or later and Windows VST3. The Windows build matches version

, and I have received reports that it works well. Windows AAX support is planned for a future release. This update may resolve an issue where the plug-in could fail to load in some environments, but this has not been fully confirmed yet.
of a source without relying on reverb alone.
in a way that is more convincing than simple tonal darkening.
Aim for subtle, mix-friendly depth control that can sit naturally inside a real mix.
Be especially useful when a source needs to move just a little in depth, even if the difference is not dramatic on every sound.
rather than a flashy special effect, with future algorithm improvements still planned.
Screenshot: shaping the apparent depth and distance of a source.
Current release. This update may resolve an issue where the plug-in could fail to load in some environments, but this has not been fully confirmed yet.

Help dialogue, foley, or effects feel a few meters farther away in a more believable way.
Create clearer front-to-back placement when EQ and reverb alone do not quite get there.
